senses.definition: (transitive) To connect, set up or prepare something for use

quotes.text: Across Japan, technology companies and private investors are racing to install devices that until recently they had little interest in: solar panels. Massive solar parks are popping up as part of a rapid build-up that one developer likened to an "explosion."
quotes.reference: 2013 June 21, Chico Harlan, “Japan pockets the subsidy …”, in The Guardian Weekly, volume 189, number 2, page 30:

quotes.text: Each TBM installs two-metre-wide rings made up of seven precast concrete segments produced on-site. Each ring takes approximately 45 minutes to one hour to install.
quotes.reference: 2021 July 14, Paul Stephen, “A portal into the future”, in RAIL, number 935, page 52. photo caption:

subsenses.definition: (transitive, computing) To transfer software onto a device's permanent storage and put it in a state where it is ready to be run when needed, usually decompressing it if necessary and performing any necessary pre-first-run configuration.
examples: I haven't installed the new operating system yet because of all the bugs.

senses.definition: (transitive) To admit formally into an office, rank or position.
examples: He was installed as Chancellor of the University.

quotes.text: My husband rented a small, comfortable house, and I was installed as its mistress.
quotes.reference: 1861, E. J. Guerin, Mountain Charley, page 12:

senses.definition: (transitive, sometimes reflexive) To establish or settle in.
examples: I installed myself in my usual chair by the fire.

quotes.text: At Kiwi, 40 miles from Nelson [New Zealand], eight women installed themselves in the goods shed, taking with them their knitting, and a supply of food and magazines. The demolition crew was unable to pull the building down without injuring them.
quotes.reference: 1955 December, “Notes and News: Women Delay Railway Demolition”, in Railway Magazine, page 878:

senses.definition: (computing, informal) An installation: the process of installing a software application.
examples: The install takes a long time, but you can run it in the background while working on other things.

senses.definition: (computing, informal) An installation: a software application that has been installed.
examples: I've customized my local install; the out-of-the-box version looks a bit different.
